# Business plan

## Problem

Volunteer hall managers lose evenings reconciling double bookings by phone (user, D-001).

## Value proposition

For volunteer hall managers, bookings stop colliding, unlike the shared phone diary they use today (user, D-001).

## Payer and user

The hall committee pays. Residents and the manager use it (user, D-002).

## Alternatives

A shared phone diary fails because two volunteers can promise the same slot (user, D-001).

## Market notes

None gathered. Research was not run for this fixture (assumption, A-001).

## Revenue model

Not applicable: the product is run by the hall committee, not sold.

## Success metrics

No double booking is confirmed during the MVP (user, D-005).

## Assumptions

- A-001: jurisdiction is unknown.
